function.name: write_file
function.description: Creates or overwrites a Java source file on disk. Use this FIRST — before javac or java. Always provide both filename (ending in .java) and content (valid Java source code matching the filename).

filename.description: Target filename for the Java source file. Must end with .java. Write to the current directory (no paths like ./src/).

content.description: Full Java source code. Must include a public class declaration matching the filename (e.g. public class ClassName). Use Java 17+ syntax. No external dependencies — standard library only.

function.name: javac
function.description: Compiles a .java file that already exists on disk (created by a prior write_file call). Only proceed to java after this succeeds. If compilation fails, use write_file again to fix errors.

filename.description: Name of the .java file to compile. Must match a file you already created with write_file.

function.name: java
function.description: Runs a compiled Java class (must have called javac successfully first). Do not call this before javac completes without errors. The args array holds command-line arguments for the program main(String[]) method.

class_name.description: Name of the compiled class to run. Do not add .class extension. Must match the public class declaration in your .java file and equal the filename without extension.

args.description: Arguments passed to the Java main method. Example: ["11"] for N=11, ["1000"] for N=1000.

function.name: search_okf
function.description: Search the OKF knowledge bundle for skills, context, or examples. Searches trusted_bundles first (human-vetted), then new_bundles (agent-created). Use this BEFORE implementing new functionality to check if it already exists.

query.description: Search query — keywords to find in OKF skill/knowledge files (e.g. 'prime factors', 'date utility', 'bitcoin price')

function.name: create_skill
function.description: Create a new skill definition in the OKF knowledge bundle. Writes to knowledge/new_bundles/skills/ for human review. Use this to document new capabilities before implementing them.

description.description: What this skill does, its inputs, and expected outputs

function.name: promote_skill
function.description: Promote a skill from new_bundles (unvetted) to trusted_bundles (human-approved). Use after user reviews and approves a skill.

skill_name.description: Name of the skill to promote (must exist in knowledge/new_bundles/skills/)

function.name: view_concept
function.description: View the full content of an OKF concept. Use this to read detailed knowledge before implementing. Returns the complete markdown content with frontmatter.

concept_id.description: The concept ID to view (e.g. 'how-do-i-shell-commands', 'how-do-i-ralph'). Search first with search_okf to find concept IDs.
